mentions.name: ChessCraft
mentions.description: A chess variant AI sandbox whose adventure mode is being extended with an overly elaborate item and levelling up system. Items use a Diablo 2-style prefix and suffix system, and the mode revolves around a cycle of gems, items, and experience that gives no advantage in the chess games themselves.
